description: Test whether pathogenic ABAT missense variants lie closer to the PLP cofactor than population-tolerated missense variants
code:
import requests, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0"})
pdb = S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1OHV.pdb", timeout=120).text
hseq = S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P80404.json", timeout=120).json()["sequence"]["value"]

aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
atoms=[]
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
        atoms.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(), name=l[12:16].strip(), resn=l[17:20].strip(),
                          chain=l[21], resi=int(l[22:26]), x=float(l[30:38]),
                          y=float(l[38:46]), z=float(l[46:54])))
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms)

ca = A[(A.chain=="A")&(A.name=="CA")&(A.resn.isin(aa3))][["resi","resn","x","y","z"]].drop_duplicates("resi").sort_values("resi")
ca["aa"]=ca.resn.map(aa3)
best=None
for off in range(0,60):
    ok=[(ca.aa.iloc[i]==hseq[ca.resi.iloc[i]+off-1]) for i in range(len(ca)) if 0 < ca.resi.iloc[i]+off <= len(hseq)]
    f=np.mean(ok) if ok else 0
    if best is None or f>best[1]: best=(off,f)
OFF,IDENT=best
print(f"best precursor-numbering offset = +{OFF}, sequence identity = {IDENT:.3f} (pig 1OHV vs human P80404)")
ca["pres"]=ca.resi+OFF
print("catalytic Lys357 check: 1OHV residue", 357-OFF, "=", ca.set_index('pres').loc[357,'resn'])

# cofactor atoms: PLP ring and the [2Fe-2S] cluster, chain A
plp = A[(A.resn=="PLP")&(A.chain=="A")][["x","y","z"]].values
fes = A[(A.resn=="FES")&(A.chain=="A")][["x","y","z"]].values
print("PLP atoms (chain A):",len(plp)," FES atoms (chain A):",len(fes))
# also use chain B cofactors: the active site sits at the dimer interface
plpB = A[(A.resn=="PLP")&(A.chain=="B")][["x","y","z"]].values
cof = np.vstack([plp,plpB])

XYZ = ca[["x","y","z"]].values
d_plp = np.min(np.linalg.norm(XYZ[:,None,:]-cof[None,:,:],axis=2),axis=1)
d_fes = np.min(np.linalg.norm(XYZ[:,None,:]-fes[None,:,:],axis=2),axis=1) if len(fes) else np.full(len(ca),np.nan)
ca["d_plp"]=d_plp; ca["d_fes"]=d_fes
dist = ca.set_index("pres")[["aa","d_plp","d_fes"]]

# ---- variant sets (human precursor numbering) -----------------------------
patho = {152:"P152S",211:"L211F",478:"L478P",220:"R220K",296:"Q296H",377:"R377W",
         92:"R92Q",213:"F213C",465:"G465D",465.1:"G465R"}
patho_pos = sorted({int(p) for p in patho})
# tolerated set: gnomAD missense alleles with AF >= 1e-5 (seen many times, no disease report)
q="""query { gene(gene_symbol:"ABAT", reference_genome:GRCh38){
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ hgvsp consequence exome{ac an} genome{ac an} } } }"""
S.headers.update({"Content-Type":"application/json"})
vs=S.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",data=json.dumps({"query":q}),timeout=300).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
rows=[]
for v in vs:
    if v["consequence"]!="missense_variant": continue
    e=v.get("exome") or {}; g=v.get("genome") or {}
    ac=(e.get("ac") or 0)+(g.get("ac") or 0); an=(e.get("an") or 0)+(g.get("an") or 0)
    hp=v.get("hgvsp") or ""
    import re as _re
    mm=_re.match(r"p\.[A-Za-z]{3}(\d+)[A-Za-z]{3}$",hp)
    if mm: rows.append(dict(pos=int(mm.group(1)), af=ac/an if an else 0))
M=pd.DataFrame(rows)
tol = sorted(set(M.loc[M.af>=1e-5,"pos"]) - set(patho_pos))
print(f"\npathogenic missense positions: {patho_pos}")
print(f"tolerated (gnomAD AF>=1e-5) missense positions: n={len(tol)}")

dp = dist.reindex(patho_pos).dropna(subset=["d_plp"])
dt = dist.reindex(tol).dropna(subset=["d_plp"])
print(f"\nmodelled: pathogenic n={len(dp)}, tolerated n={len(dt)}")
u,p = stats.mannwhitneyu(dp.d_plp, dt.d_plp, alternative="less")
# rank-biserial effect size
rbc = 1 - 2*u/(len(dp)*len(dt)) if False else (2*u/(len(dp)*len(dt)) - 1)
print(f"distance to PLP cofactor (CA, angstrom): pathogenic median {dp.d_plp.median():.1f} "
      f"(IQR {dp.d_plp.quantile(.25):.1f}-{dp.d_plp.quantile(.75):.1f}), "
      f"tolerated median {dt.d_plp.median():.1f} (IQR {dt.d_plp.quantile(.25):.1f}-{dt.d_plp.quantile(.75):.1f})")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u:.0f}, one-sided p={p:.4g}, rank-biserial r={rbc:+.3f}")
u2,p2 = stats.mannwhitneyu(dp.d_fes, dt.d_fes, alternative="less")
print(f"distance to [2Fe-2S]: pathogenic median {dp.d_fes.median():.1f}, tolerated median {dt.d_fes.median():.1f}, p={p2:.4g}")
print("\nper-variant distances:")
print(dp.assign(label=[patho[i] if i in patho else f"{i}" for i in dp.index]).round(1).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
a=ax[0]
parts=a.violinplot([dt.d_plp.values,dp.d_plp.values],showmedians=True,widths=.8)
for pc,c in zip(parts['bodies'],["#a0aec0","#c53030"]): pc.set_facecolor(c); pc.set_alpha(.6)
a.scatter(np.random.default_rng(0).normal(2,.05,len(dp)),dp.d_plp,color="#742a2a",zorder=3,s=28)
a.set_xticks([1,2]); a.set_xticklabels([f"gnomAD missense\nAF>=1e-5 (n={len(dt)})",f"pathogenic\n(n={len(dp)})"])
a.set_ylabel("CA distance to PLP cofactor (A)")
a.set_title(f"Pathogenic ABAT missense sit near the cofactor\nMann-Whitney p = {p:.3g}, rank-biserial r = {rbc:+.2f}")
a.grid(alpha=.3,axis="y")

b=ax[1]
b.plot(dist.index, dist.d_plp, color="#cbd5e0", lw=1)
b.scatter(dt.index, dt.d_plp, color="#4a5568", s=14, label="gnomAD AF>=1e-5")
b.scatter(dp.index, dp.d_plp, color="#c53030", s=55, zorder=4, label="pathogenic")
for i,r in dp.iterrows():
    b.annotate(patho.get(i,str(i)), (i,r.d_plp), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,7),
               ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#742a2a")
b.axhline(10,ls=":",color="k",lw=1); b.text(60,10.6,"10 A active-site shell",fontsize=7)
b.set_xlabel("ABAT residue (P80404 precursor numbering)")
b.set_ylabel("CA distance to PLP (A)")
b.set_title("Position along the chain")
b.legend(fontsize=8); b.grid(alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
